appearances.title: Side-by-side on one RTX 5090: Inkling 2 Mini codes at 318.7 tok/s on Basalt, 205.1 on TensorFold and 111.1 on llama.cpp
appearances.summary: A builder ran three local engines on the same card and prompts: Basalt was fastest, TensorFold scored slightly higher on IFEval with similar overall quality, and llama.cpp could not hold 128K context with drafting on. A practical guide to picking a local engine for this model.
